c_calloc_leak_ml.rationale: calloc belongs to the malloc/free family and is nullable.

c_malloc_c_double_free_df.rationale: Two distinct Rust call sites inline the same C free wrapper; both are deallocation events for the same malloc-family allocation.

c_malloc_c_free_clean.rationale: Matching malloc-family allocation and C free; must not be reported as allocator UB.

c_malloc_c_free_then_rust_use_uaf.rationale: malloc-family allocation is freed inside inlined C/LLVM; a later Rust ptr::read is reachable from that free in the global ICFG.

c_malloc_cstr_borrow_c_free_clean.rationale: Borrowed CStr view does not take ownership; C free remains matching deallocator.

c_malloc_leak_ml.rationale: C malloc -> Rust; possible live allocation is never freed.

c_malloc_rust_box_from_raw_ub.rationale: Positive C malloc-family provenance does not prove Box::from_raw's Global-allocator/layout/value safety contract; report potential UB.

c_malloc_rust_double_free_df.rationale: The same C malloc-family allocation is passed twice to C free from Rust.

c_malloc_rust_free_clean.rationale: C malloc-family allocation reclaimed by the matching C free deallocator, even though free is invoked at a Rust call site.

c_malloc_rust_free_then_use_uaf.rationale: Matching C free occurs at a Rust MIR source span, followed by ptr::read of the same C-origin allocation.

c_malloc_rust_std_dealloc_ub.rationale: Positive C malloc-family provenance does not prove std::alloc::dealloc's Global-allocator + matching-Layout contract; report potential UB.

c_malloc_rust_string_from_raw_parts_ub.rationale: Positive C malloc-family provenance does not prove String::from_raw_parts' Global-allocator, capacity, and UTF-8 safety contract; report potential UB.

c_malloc_rust_vec_from_raw_parts_ub.rationale: Positive C malloc-family provenance does not prove Vec::from_raw_parts' Global-allocator/layout/length/capacity contract; report potential UB.

c_static_cstr_borrow_clean.rationale: Negative provenance control: a foreign pointer is not automatically a malloc allocation.

rust_box_direct_c_free_ub.rationale: Symmetric negative control: positive Rust Box/global-allocation tracking reaches direct C free. The new Rust-call-site free support must not suppress the existing Rust-to-C allocator warning.
